title: Render Props
description: Learn the render props pattern for sharing logic between components.
longDescription: The render props pattern is a technique for sharing code between React components using a function prop. In this module you will learn how render props work, see practical examples like toggles and data fetchers, and compare them with the modern hooks alternative.
whatYouLearn: Understand what render props are and how they enable component composition
Use children as a render prop for natural JSX syntax
Build reusable logic with render prop components like Toggle and DataFetcher
Compare render props with custom hooks and choose the right pattern
Apply render props to share logic without prop drilling
